data.one_liner: Interpolated progress builder for video_player controllers to make progress bars smooth.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SmoothVideoProgress widget that interpolates video progress for video_player controllers, eliminating the choppy UX of infrequent default progress updates. It is completely unopinionated regarding UI design.
use_when: You are using the official video_player package and want a smooth, high-framerate progress bar or slider
You need more accurate time displays or animations tied to video playback position
avoid_when: You are using an alternative video player library that is not video_player
You do not want a dependency on flutter_hooks
strengths: Eliminates choppy video progress UI updates
weaknesses: Only works with the standard video_player controller
data.setup_notes: Requires video_player setup steps for your target platforms.
data.minimal_example:
SmoothVideoProgress(
  controller: controller,
  builder: (context, position, duration, child) => Slider(
    onChangeStart: (_) => controller.pause(),
    onChangeEnd: (_) => controller.play(),
    onChanged: (value) =>
        controller.seekTo(Duration(milliseconds: value.toInt())),
    value: position.inMilliseconds.toDouble(),
    min: 0,
    max: duration.inMilliseconds.toDouble(),
  ),
);
